simulatedReaderProbe.prompt: Does a stronger AI model prove it should be allowed to send a work document?
simulatedReaderProbe.probeResponse: No. A stronger model changes capability; the surrounding system determines which files and actions it can reach. Sending should still remain behind human approval unless a bounded, reviewed workflow says otherwise.
simulatedReaderProbe.expectedEvidence: Separates capability from access and approval.

simulatedReaderProbe.prompt: A vendor says its assistant has a new model and better health-care predictions. What should a workplace buyer ask?
simulatedReaderProbe.probeResponse: Ask what task changed, which data or actions the system may access, what evidence supports the claimed prediction, and whether using it has demonstrated benefit in the intended setting. A model release and a prediction result are not blanket approval.
